STEP 2 - Vessel: Dinner plate, about 26 cm diameter. Area = 3.14 x 13^2 ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Roast chicken pieces (skin-on, with some bone)

- Potatoes: 106 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 212 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken: 199 ml x 0.95 ≈ 189 g
- Potatoes: 212 ml x 0.9 ≈ 191 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken: 189 g x 190 kcal/100 g ≈ 359 kcal
- Potatoes: 191 g x 110 kcal/100 g ≈ 210 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 380 g of food covering roughly half of a dinner plate, around 570 kcal. This is plausible for a roast chicken and potato portion.
